title: Large Language Models’ Detection of Political Orientation in Newspapers

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting multiple LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Gemini Pro, Gemini Pro 1.5) to rate 1,000 scraped newspaper articles from 40 global outlets on a two-dimensional political compass (measuring Economic Left/Right and Libertarian/Authoritarian orientations) and analyzing the distribution, variance, and cross-consistency of their scores.

Evaluating LLM assessments of news articles on a quantitative Economic Scale ranging from -10 (Economic Left) to 10 (Economic Right) to determine if models consistently identify the economic alignment of various global newspapers.
